source_review.notes: Checked all nine references for identity, authority, date, and claim scope. Current Kubernetes documentation supports Deployment budget rounding, minReadySeconds, progress-deadline reporting without automatic rollback, probe purposes, terminating EndpointSlice state, serving-condition use, termination signaling, and forced stop after grace. Those claims are explicitly Kubernetes-specific. Google SRE sources support risk-shaped progressive rollout and the distinction between rollout mechanics and evaluated canary exposure. Humble/Farley, Nygard, and RFC 9110 support durable delivery, stability, timeout, and protocol vocabulary. Checked 2026-09-06.

Checked floor, ceiling, summation, inequality, subscript, and text operators for GitHub-renderable delimiters and dimensional meaning.
